paragraphs: The external frame pack was pushed aside by soft designs and then quietly kept working. A rigid frame holds the load off the back, air moves between the two, and heavy or awkward things can be strapped to the outside of it in a way no internal frame allows.
The model holds 69,659 polygons and 70,563 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $69 it suits outdoor and retail visualisation, e-commerce imagery, advertising, character accessories, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

Food photography runs on props that suggest a moment rather than a meal. A cup with something to stir it and something to eat beside it says morning, pause, warmth, and it does that faster than any amount of styling around it.
The model is very light at 9,779 polygons and 9,614 vertices in quads and tris with mixed UV layout, so it can be dropped into any interior. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $69 it suits food and hospitality visualisation, packaging and product imagery, cafe and interior scenes, advertising, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

The house centipede is the fastest thing most people will ever see indoors, and it is genuinely on their side: it eats spiders, silverfish and everything else living in the skirting boards. The legs get longer towards the back so they can overlap without tangling at speed.
The model holds 61,040 polygons and 60,668 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, groomed with fur. It is built to CheckMate specification, and a rigged build is offered separately.
At $69 it suits nature and education visualisation, pest control and domestic material, horror and film props, game creatures, advertising and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

A rack server opened up is a lesson in airflow. Everything inside is arranged in a straight line from the fans at the front to the exhaust at the back, and the drive bays, boards and cabling are all positioned around not getting in the way of moving air.

This is a heavy technical model at 3,186,277 polygons and 3,189,343 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 12 maps all at 4096x4096, supplied opened with the disks visible. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $69 it suits data centre and IT visualisation, hardware marketing and technical documentation, training material, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2020.

A scrubber lays down water, works it with a brush and lifts it back off in one pass, which is why a supermarket floor is dry behind the machine. Doing that without leaving a wet strip anyone can slip on is the whole engineering problem.
The model is light at 37,759 polygons and 37,760 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in grey, and carries StemCell certification.
At $69 it suits facilities and cleaning equipment visualisation, retail and industrial interiors, equipment marketing, training material, film sets and game environments. On sale since 2024.

Pipework is the handwriting of an industrial site. Diameters, bends and supports are all determined by what is flowing and how fast, and a plant reads as real or fake almost entirely on whether the runs look like they were designed rather than drawn.
The model holds 945,458 polygons and 956,169 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 9 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $69 it suits industrial and process visualisation, refinery and plant scenes, infrastructure presentation, film backgrounds, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.

A modern protective mask carries its filters on the cheeks rather than in front, which sounds cosmetic and is not: it clears the space a rifle sight needs. Every design decision on one of these is a compromise between breathing, seeing and being able to work.
The model holds 58,982 polygons and 60,009 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $69 it suits defence and safety visualisation, protective equipment marketing, training material, character work, film props, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

The large screen laptop is a desktop that occasionally travels. It is bought by people who work on one machine all day and want the display to prove it, and the size is chosen for the screen rather than for anything to do with portability.
The model is light at 55,849 polygons and 58,682 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in white, so it drops into any interior. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $69 it suits product and technology visualisation, screen and interface mockups, office and interior scenes, e-commerce imagery, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

A light helicopter panel is small enough that every instrument on it has to justify its space. There is no room for redundancy or comfort, so what remains is the irreducible set of things a pilot cannot fly without.

The model is light at 22,110 polygons and 24,020 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 13 maps, 2 at 4096x4096 and the rest smaller. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $69 it suits aviation training and simulation, cockpit and interior visualisation, equipment presentation, film sets, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.

Marmots spend more than half their lives asleep underground, and the rest of it standing upright on a rock watching for eagles. That sentry posture is the only way most people have ever seen one, and it is the pose the animal is recognised by.

The model is very light at 13,122 polygons and 6,779 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and rigged builds are offered separately, including native rigs for Cinema 4D, Maya and Modo.
At $69 it suits wildlife and nature visualisation, mountain and landscape scenes, documentary and education work, game creatures, advertising and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.

Concrete has a shelf life measured in tens of minutes, which is why a plant that can be trucked to the job exists at all. If the site is far enough from a fixed batching plant, the only answer is to bring the mixing to the pour.

The model is light at 58,343 polygons and 62,988 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 2 maps at 4096x4096, suited to wide site scenes. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $69 it suits construction and infrastructure visualisation, equipment marketing, site scenes, training material, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2019.

The appeal of a capsule dwelling is that it arrives finished. No trades on site, no weather delays, no planning for a foundation beyond something level, which is why the idea keeps being taken up by people building where conventional construction is impractical.
The model holds 68,349 polygons and 73,673 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification.
At $69 it suits architectural and modular housing visualisation, property and innovation presentation, landscape and remote scenes, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2025.

A satellite is mostly wings. The bus in the middle is small, dense and expensive, and the panels either side of it are enormous because everything the spacecraft will ever do depends on how much sunlight it can turn into power.
The model holds 91,142 polygons and 94,229 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification.
At $69 it suits space and technology visualisation, news and documentary graphics, education and museum work, advertising, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The mosquito is the deadliest animal on earth by a wide margin, and it is the female doing it: she needs the protein to develop eggs. The proboscis is not a needle but a bundle of tools, some of which saw while others inject an anticoagulant.
The model is very light at 9,270 polygons and 9,288 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 7 maps all at 4096x4096, in the feeding pose. It carries StemCell certification.

At $69 it suits medical and public health visualisation, education and documentary work, pest control and pharmaceutical material, advertising, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2017.
